question: What is the meaning of storage instructions in relation to material health?
description: Storage instructions ensure that materials are kept in appropriate conditions to prevent deterioration affecting compliance with regulations. This includes maintaining climate-controlled storage for electronics and other sensitive materials to prevent damage. The instructions also cover the storage and transport of materials to ensure compliance with standards. The manufacturer or authorized representative is responsible for maintaining these conditions until the product is in the market. The storage and transport conditions are crucial for maintaining the integrity and compliance of materials with regulations.

tenance services such as replacement and upgrades. This can help with
budgeting and reducing unexpected downtime. Location identification
is another relevant piece of information for facility management and
maintenance scheduling, enabling quicker identification during in-
spections, repairs or relocations. Maintenance covers the individuals
and teams responsible for maintenance, recommended maintenance
measures, repair procedures and safety precautions. Recording the
installation date can help track the product’s age and performance over
time. It helps in scheduling regular maintenance and anticipating po-
tential issues of wear and tear.
